about: Phase-2 lab results (rs/543), transcribed per bot from rate.ts / hp-train.ts RESULT lines; the raw logs were in executor scratch and are gone. NODE_TICKRATE=400; per-hour figures are per 9,000 server ticks, so a stretched tick (msPerTick) does not change them. Mining runs had player_count.rs2 pinned to 1,400 (emulate-players.sh). Bots m8*/m9*/s8* are lab placeholders.
